articles.title: What Nedbank Group Shareholders Got Right
articles.summary: If Nedbank Group sat on your watchlist instead of in your portfolio, the recent performance may feel like a missed shot. Investors who held Nedbank Group over the past year are up 20.5%, including dividends. That outcome lands against a backdrop of earlier debate, with one camp focused on digital banking gains and African expansion, and another worried about legacy IT and rising regulation.
